name: cashier_event_append_only
definition: CREATE TRIGGER cashier_event_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.accounting_cashier_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_cashier_event_append_only()
function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_cashier_event_append_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'cashier_event_is_immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';END $function$

name: trg_ca_autoledger
definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_ca_autoledger AFTER UPDATE OF agent_wallet_balance, promo_wallet_balance ON public.agents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_autoledger('agent_wallet_balance=agent_wallet', 'promo_wallet_balance=promo_wallet')

name: trg_ca_autoledger_insert
definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_ca_autoledger_insert AFTER INSERT ON public.agents FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((COALESCE(new.agent_wallet_balance, (0)::numeric) <> (0)::numeric) OR (COALESCE(new.promo_wallet_balance, (0)::numeric) <> (0)::numeric))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_ca_autoledger('agent_wallet_balance=agent_wallet', 'promo_wallet_balance=promo_wallet')

name: accounting_invoice_deliver
definition: CREATE TRIGGER accounting_invoice_deliver AFTER INSERT ON public.settlement_invoices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_accounting_invoice_deliver_on_insert()
function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_accounting_invoice_deliver_on_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.fn_deliver_accounting_invoice(NEW.id);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
